author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam checks out two hero costumes worn by Arnold Schwarzenegger as the T-800 from The Terminator and Terminator 2: Judgment Day! These iconic jackets helped shape the silhouette and physicality of the career-defining role, but are actually very different. Which costume do you more closely associate with The Terminator? 

Learn more about these costumes and props and see more details at: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/496

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
